description: Roadside monument on the Route Économique at Benguia, about 3.8 km north of Franceville-Mvengue airport. Construction number 365; the registration is unknown to the source and is left blank rather than guessed. Independently present in OpenStreetMap as node 4987022766, tagged historic=aircraft and tourism=attraction and named Fouga-Magister, which is a separate on-the-ground mapping. Esri WorldView-2 imagery of 5 April 2017 shows a pale cruciform object roughly ten metres across on open ground at the tagged position, consistent with a Magister. Gabon's Fougas were ex-Austrian aircraft in the same construction-number band as the 366 and 368 recorded in service, which makes 365 plausible.
